title: THE STRANGER · 25 AUGUST
summary: The promised appraisal prints on its promised day, assembled live from every leg that still holds data: four weeks of door-level joins, one honest gap that stays a gap, and a verdict of three machine readers that returned on two or more days — five under a wider subnet cut — every one drawn by llms.txt, while the record's own fetch-daily door earned zero repeaters beyond the desk itself. The room is no longer empty; its regulars read the sign, not the paper.
